title: Replace a conveyancer licence
summary: You can apply for a replacement conveyancer licence if your current licence has been lost, stolen, or damaged.
intro:
If your conveyancer licence has been damaged, lost or stolen, you can apply for a replacement licence at a Service NSW Centre or by email.

To check your conveyancer licence number and details visit Verify NSW.
who_can_apply: The licence must be damaged, lost, or stolen.
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Application for a Replacement Licence'

how_to_steps.text: Complete the form and submit it:

faqs.q: How can I check my conveyancer licence number and details?
faqs.a: You can check your conveyancer licence number and details by visiting Verify NSW.

faqs.q: How do I apply for a replacement licence?
faqs.a: You can apply for a replacement licence at a Service NSW Centre or by email.

faqs.q: What do I need to apply for a replacement licence?
faqs.a: You need the 'Application for a Replacement Licence' PDF form, your licence number, and payment for the fee.
